topArticle.title: Ebola outbreak in DRC the fastest growing in the history of the virus
topArticle.description:
As the death toll rises to almost 1,500, and with a vaccine against the Bundibugyo strain potentially still months away, health workers face a battle to slow the outbreak
The latest numbers of confirmed cases of Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has made this latest outbreak the fastest growing in the known history of the virus.
At 3,360 confirmed cases, the disease is now affecting people in five provinces in the east of the DRC, with 1,487 deaths recorded, representing an overall case fatality rate estimated at about 45%, according to Congolese health officials. Health responses to the outbreak have been badly hampered by conflict in many of the affected areas.

topArticle.title: Fifteen elephant deaths in Kenya may be due to cyanide poisoning

Analysis of samples collected from carcasses found traces of toxic chemical compound, says Kenya Wildlife Service
The recent deaths of 15 elephants near a park in southern Kenya were likely caused by the animals ingesting pesticides used on tomato farms, the Kenya Wildlife Service (KWS) has said.
Erustus Kanga, the agency’s director general, told Citizen TV that analysis of samples collected from the carcasses had found traces of cyanide, a chemical compound used in farming as a predator control poison and a pest fumigant, which has also been used by poachers.

topArticle.title: Millions opposed military rule in Myanmar. Is their dream of a revolution over?
topArticle.description: Opponents of the junta hoped a revolution would remake Myanmar - but these are disheartening times.
topArticle.titleJa: ミャンマーで軍事支配に反対する数百万の人々。彼らの革命の夢は終わったのか？
topArticle.summary: ミャンマーで軍事政権に反対する人々は革命を望んだが、現況は彼らの夢を打ち砕き、希望を失わせている。

topArticle.title: Trade Policy Review: India
topArticle.description: The Eighth review of the trade policies and practices of India takes place on 21 and 23 July 2026. The basis for the review is a report by the WTO Secretariat and a report by the Government of India.
topArticle.titleJa: 貿易政策レビュー：インド
topArticle.summary: 2026年7月21日と23日に、インドの貿易政策と慣行に関する第8回レビューが実施される。WTO事務局とインド政府の報告書に基づき評価。

topArticle.title: BTS withdraw from Grammys, a month after Asian pop prize introduced
topArticle.description: All seven members of the band post a statement online, saying they will boycott the 2027 ceremony.
topArticle.titleJa: BTS、アジアポップ賞導入1ヶ月後にグラミー賞辞退
topArticle.summary: 人気グループBTSが、アジアポップ賞が導入されてわずか1ヶ月後、2027年のグラミー賞授賞式をボイコットすると発表した。

topArticle.title: WTO panel issues report regarding Turkish measures on EVs and other types of vehicles
topArticle.description: On 28 July, the WTO circulated the panel report in the case brought by China in "Türkiye — Measures Concerning Electric Vehicles and Other Types of Vehicles from China" (DS629).
topArticle.titleJa: WTOパネル、トルコのEVなど車両措置に関する報告書を発行
topArticle.summary: WTOは7月28日、「トルコ—中国製電気自動車およびその他の車種に関する措置」事件（DS629）におけるパネル報告書を回覧した。中国が提起したこの件について、トルコの措置が焦点となっている。

topArticle.title: Lithuania gives EUR 30,000 to help developing economies and LDCs improve trade skillset
topArticle.description: Lithuania is contributing EUR 30,000 (approximately CHF 28,000) in 2026 to finance training programmes for government officials from developing economies, including least-developed countries (LDCs). This contribution to the WTO Global Trust Fund will support these economies in deepening their expertise on WTO issues and help them participate more effectively in the rules-based multilateral trading system.
topArticle.titleJa: リトアニア、発展途上国と後発開発途上国の貿易スキル向上に3万ユーロを拠出
topArticle.summary: リトアニアは、発展途上国および後発開発途上国の政府関係者向けの貿易研修プログラムを支援するため、WTOグローバル信託基金に3万ユーロを拠出。多角的貿易システムの効果的な参加を促進する。
